descriptions.zh-Hans: 我在新加坡尝过海南鸡饭后写的小菜单。开头只写了半句，后半句等我吃好才回来。
descriptions.en: A menu from my chicken rice lunch in Singapore. The sentence paused for a spoonful and resumed after the meal.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 我尝过新加坡咖椰吐司后留的菜单，短短一道记号，记的是自己咬下那口的轻响。
descriptions.en: A menu after kaya toast in Singapore, with a tiny mark for the crunch I heard.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 在新加坡鱼尾狮旁碰头，我和旅人从两边各说了一声“在这里”。两声都留在这张自己的便签上。
descriptions.en: Two calls of “over here” from a meeting by Singapore’s Merlion, saved on my own slip.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 在新加坡吃咖椰吐司时，我给自己听见的脆响留了一个小记号。这张纸不会真的响。
descriptions.en: My mark for a crunch of kaya toast in Singapore. The paper itself is pleasantly quiet.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 在新加坡植物园慢走时，我看叶影从鞋尖挪开，回去才写下“多站了一会儿”。
descriptions.en: A note written after a pause at Singapore Botanic Gardens, watching a leaf shadow move away from my shoes.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 从新加坡鱼尾狮旁的碰头记忆折成的小卡，一边写“这边见”，一边写“慢慢走”，是我自己的招呼。
descriptions.en: A homemade card from my Merlion meeting in Singapore: “Meet here” on one side and “Take your time” on the other.
